Earth Federation Common Law

Establishes universal common citizenship and a unified right of external representation, while each region retains its day-to-day laws and private property; joint institutions are limited to the legal authority granted by written treaties.
Earthwide Compact

The major regions unify the surface through a binding common code, joint arbitration, and full authority to represent Earth externally; internal governing bodies and local storehouse accounts remain independent.
